authorReview.scope: Complete eight-sentence script checked against canonical short-reader opening evidence for premise, clear identity, specific interest and protected revelations.

independentReview.notes: Every spoken sentence reviewed against canonical English short reader for clear newcomer meaning, source grounding, curiosity and emotional intent. Replaced abstract promotional commentary with concrete viewer-facing language. All eight sentences have a distinct intended response and explicit restrained TTS direction; fictional later outcomes remain withheld. This is editorial review, not audience testing or rendered-audio approval.

sentenceIntentions.text: The work becomes a duty, the risk an opportunity, and someone else still carries the cost.
sentenceIntentions.purpose: Expose burdens renamed as duty or opportunity
sentenceIntentions.viewerResponse: Recognize respectable language around unequal cost

sentenceIntentions.text: Holding the Dirty Thing by the Clean Side examines the language that makes burdens easier to accept.
sentenceIntentions.purpose: Name the inquiry into accepting burdens

sentenceIntentions.text: It moves from religious duty and sacrifice to management reports, market pressure, and official explanations.
sentenceIntentions.purpose: Move from sacred authority to management and markets
sentenceIntentions.viewerResponse: Expect the pattern across different institutions

sentenceIntentions.text: The book takes the appeal of these stories seriously, including the genuine coordination they can make possible.
sentenceIntentions.purpose: Preserve the genuine usefulness of shared stories
sentenceIntentions.viewerResponse: Avoid dismissing every justification as manipulation

sentenceIntentions.text: That makes its central question harder: when does a necessary justification also hide an unequal arrangement?
sentenceIntentions.purpose: Ask when necessity hides an unequal arrangement
sentenceIntentions.viewerResponse: Feel the moral ambiguity rather than a simple accusation

sentenceIntentions.text: It follows the distance between those who describe a decision and those who must live with it.
sentenceIntentions.purpose: Contrast explaining decisions with living their consequences
sentenceIntentions.viewerResponse: Recognize an asymmetry of power and experience

sentenceIntentions.text: Necessary duties remain real, but so does the question of why the same people keep carrying the heavier share.
sentenceIntentions.purpose: Make scrutiny compatible with necessary obligations
sentenceIntentions.viewerResponse: Expect a careful critique without institutional cynicism

sentenceIntentions.text: Begin with an ordinary burden, and listen carefully to the explanation wrapped around it.
sentenceIntentions.purpose: Return to an ordinary burden and its explanation
sentenceIntentions.viewerResponse: Want to hear which costs the honorable language leaves outside
